en-US.name: billy
en-US.summary: Development endpoint that captures raw Alexa requests.
en-US.description: A development-only skill for jamestelfer/billy. It points at a self-hosted endpoint reached over Tailscale Funnel, which records the raw bytes of every request Alexa sends so that signature verification can be built against a real corpus. It plays nothing and is never submitted for certification.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask audiobookshelf to capture a request
Alexa, ask audiobookshelf to test the endpoint

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development only. The endpoint does not verify request signatures yet, so this skill must not be submitted for certification.
